messages:
will_cs: Hey team - putting together a short 'Activation Signal Sheet' tailored for AMs to run pre- and post-onboarding checks. Compact, customer-facing, include troubleshooting snippets for cache/batch/stream.

notes-bot: Draft created: https://redwood.docs/drafts/activation-sheet-1820003333

emma_am: add a tiny 'first 24h watchlist' with clear owner assignments. example: watch prefill throughput, token spend, p99 latency every 2h.

will_cs: added. also included a 'quick mitigation' column mapping 1-line actions to signals. e.g., high p99 -> reduce batch target_ms to 10 and enable prefill concurrency.

raj_eng: paste sample config snippet for a streaming fallback and small client-side chunk example.

raj_eng: ```yaml
streaming:
  client_chunk_size: 800
  max_retries: 2
  server_reassembly: true
fallback_policy:
  on_stream_error: degrade_to_polling
```

claire_prod: include a short blurb about how these settings affect SLA and billing so AMs can explain to customers.

will_cs: added a short table: effect on latency, cost, and cold-start risk. included a note: if cost sensitivity high -> favor batching and smaller prefill sizes; if latency critical -> increase prefill and reduce batch target.

emma_am: can you add a single alert rule snippet for our Grafana so AMs can drop it in?

will_cs: added: `alert: HighCacheMissAndLatency
expr: avg_over_time(tenant_cache_miss_rate[6h]) > 0.15 and avg_over_time(tenant_latency_p99[6h]) > 0.7
for: 2h
labels: severity:warning
annotations: summary: 'Tenant {{ $labels.tenant }} high cache miss and latency'`

notes-bot: PDF export available: S3://internal-docs/cs/activation-sheet-1820003333.pdf

will_cs: plan to publish to AM workspace after 1 quick sanity pass. anyone object?

emma_am: go for it. I'll include in tomorrow AM standup.

will_cs: thanks. collecting feedback after 48h.
